title: Hotel lobby coffee counter (bare, with waste hole) · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Self-serve coffee counter, 3.23 x 0.66 x 0.94 m, bare: white quartz top (3 cm) with faint coffee rings, sugar grit and a wipe swirl in its gloss, vertical-grain walnut laminate panels, black carcass, scuffed charcoal plinth. A 20 cm waste hole near the right end with a black ABS grommet (stained on the tower side) over the slim bin and liner inside; dried drip trail down the front edge; wicker cookie basket with take_cookie nodes. Hook bin_opening. Origin floor centre, front +Z. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/coffee.py, labels from coffee-labels.mjs).

title: Thermal coffee dispenser tower (COFFEE / DECAF) · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Insulated thermal coffee tower on its stand (1.5 gal Luxus-type): black stand and drip tray with slotted grille, cylindrical body with a printed wrap band, level window, domed lid and handle, faucet with a push-down lever. Nodes band (COFFEE, dark blue) and band_decaf (DECAF, light blue): keep one. Hooks fill_spout, fill_point, lever (origin on pivot). Origin base underside centre, front +Z. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/coffee.py, labels from coffee-labels.mjs).

title: Angled wood cup rack with paper hot cups · original Blender model

description: Blond-oak angled rack, two tiers of two slots leaning 20 degrees, four stacks of 12 oz printed paper hot cups mouth up (one shorter, one top crushed). take_cup..take_cup003 are the top cups (origin at base), stack_0..stack_3 the rest. Origin bottom centre, front +Z. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/coffee.py, labels from coffee-labels.mjs).
